title: 第一卷 第6章 天黑
slug: 木屋求生一天一个神级特性
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

这空间里面，有一个像是三轮车控制握把一样的简陋东西。

手握住的一瞬间，秦龙就知道这是什么东西了。

这东西，是用来架势木屋的。

木屋的移动方式，原本是前面有一个拉绳。

就像是原始的架子车一样，需要自己拉着往前走。

而现在升级到了二级木屋以后。

直接可以在里面架势木屋朝着前面移动！

控制握把的正前方，还有一个小孔。

小孔不大，但是能够看的清前面的路。

这实在有点给力的，他的工作原理是什么，这点谁都不清楚。

反正不用人力拉着向前就是了。

木屋外面倒是没有太大的变化，就是木头墙壁，看起来比原来厚了一层。

最大的一个变化就是现在不是木轮子了。

取而代之的是橡胶轮胎！

不知道是在木轮子上面包裹了一层橡胶，还是全部换成了橡胶。

总之现在这木屋的移动肯定要比之前的木轮行进更加顺畅容易就是了。

架势着木屋，秦龙朝着前面的道路缓缓驶去。

速度不快，也就是三十左右，这已经是极限了。

但起码要比人力拉得要容易得多。

秦龙一走就是好几公里。

反正等明天开门，周围的环境会变，多走一点，也没有什么，这一片树林肯定是没有了。

那脑海中的声音说过，最少是一公里，没说不让多走。

早一点到看不到的山顶，说不定就解脱了这种生活。

他也想要看看，山顶所谓的扭转乾坤的是什么。

几公里之后，秦龙停了下来。

透过前面的观察孔，这里的路似乎比较平缓一点，旁边貌似还听到了水流的声音。

离天黑还剩下不到半个小时。

出去看看还能不能有收获。

末世求生的世界里面，多收集一份物资，就多一份胜算。

懒到吃饭都想要啃嘴边大饼的，终究会被淘汰。

这里，想要靠着嘴皮子生活，纯属做梦！

门外很是寂静，旁边的树林已经变成了灌木。

上面长了不少的小浆果。

不认识，不知道有没有毒，这东西红得妖艳。

秦龙摘了一颗，然后放在了交易频道上面。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

In this space, there is a simple thing like a tricycle control handle.

The moment he held it in his hand, Qin Long knew what it was.

This thing is used to frame the wooden house.

The way the cabin was moved, there was originally a pull cord in the front.

Just like the original frame car, you need to pull it forward by yourself.

But now it has been upgraded to a second-level wooden house.

You can position the wooden house directly inside and move it toward the front!

There is also a small hole right in front of the control grip.

The hole is not big, but you can see the road ahead clearly.

This is really impressive. No one knows how it works.

Anyway, there is no need to pull it forward manually.

The outside of the wooden house has not changed much, except that the wooden walls look thicker than before.

The biggest change is that there are no longer wooden wheels.

Rubber tires instead!

I don’t know if the wooden wheels are wrapped with a layer of rubber, or if they are all replaced with rubber.

In short, the movement of the wooden house now is definitely smoother and easier than the previous wooden wheel.

Setting up the wooden house, Qin Long slowly drove towards the road ahead.

The speed is not fast, that is, around thirty, which is already the limit.

But at least it's much easier than pulling it manually.

Qin Long walked several kilometers.

Anyway, when the doors open tomorrow, the surrounding environment will change. It won't matter if we walk a little more. This forest will definitely be gone.

The voice in my head said that it should be at least one kilometer, and did not say that I would not be allowed to go further.

If we reach the top of the invisible mountain earlier, we might be able to escape this kind of life.

He also wanted to see what the so-called "turnaround" on the top of the mountain was.

After a few kilometers, Qin Long stopped.

Through the observation hole in front, the road here seems to be a little gentler, and the sound of water seems to be heard next to it.

There was less than half an hour left before dark.

Go out and see if you can still gain anything.

In the world of survival at the end of the world, the more supplies you collect, the more chances you have to win.

Those who are so lazy that they even want to eat the pie in their mouths will eventually be eliminated.

Here, if you want to live by your words, it is just a dream!

It was very quiet outside the door, and the woods next to it had turned into shrubs.

There are many small berries growing on it.

I don’t know it, and I don’t know if it’s poisonous or not. This thing is so red.

Qin Long picked one and placed it on the trading channel.
